redFirst.basis: Task is gate-only with expectRedFirst false, so the helper was not run. I added dl5 first and watched it FAIL on the unfixed code (exit 1, held_now True: phase-P1 still locked), then green after the fix.

outcome.technical: drive() in drive-phase.py now wraps drive_locked in try/except ValueError, converting it to the E_STOPPED tuple before the release check, so a phase vanishing after take_lock releases the lock. Added dl5 in tests/test_drive_phase.py (load_phase patched to raise ValueError). test_drive_phase --selftest: 228/228 pass. Exit codes: sweep-selftests.py 0, --spaced 0, ruff 0, vermin 0.
outcome.descriptive: A drive stopped by a phase vanishing mid-run no longer strands the phase lock.

claims: claims: the fix covers ValueError only (the case the finding names); any other unexpected exception still propagates and is not converted. dl5 evidence: red before fix (lock held), green after, 228/228.
